overview: The Basilica of Adumbration is one of Luclin’s oldest arcane megastructures, built to stabilize void resonance and study its geometric effects.
history: Constructed by early Luclinite arcane orders to harness void resonance.
Arcane pylons were erected to channel energy into the Basilica’s core.
Custodian entities formed from void‑arcane fusion to maintain the structure.
Akhevan forces discovered the Basilica and attempted to seize its secrets.
A catastrophic resonance event destabilized the Basilica’s geometry.
campaignHooks: Disrupt Akhevan attempts to breach the sanctum.
Investigate geometric distortions in the Basilica’s halls.
